scripts.title: Galaxy sky
scripts.script:
-- Galaxy Skybox Script
local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
sky.Parent = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Galaxy textures (you can change IDs if you want different galaxy styles)
sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://159454299"
sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://159454296"
sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://159454293"
sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://159454286"
sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://159454300"
sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://159454288"

-- Optional effects
local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
lighting.Brightness = 2
lighting.ClockTime = 0 -- Night time
lighting.FogEnd = 100000
lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 80)

print("Galaxy sky applied!")

scripts.features:
Nekoblox

Speedhack – Frame-perfect WalkSpeed override (target 118 + subtle random jitter for anti-detection). Automatically reapplies on respawn.
Shoot Fast – Dual-method rapid fire:
• Tool:Activate() spam + micro-jitter timing
• ReplicatedStorage.Weapons value patching (FireRate/Cooldown etc. → 0.01) with full original-value backup & restore
• Fallback remote event firing + ClickDetector click
Recoil Control – Real-time vertical recoil compensation on equipped guns with micro-jitter for stealth. Event-driven (no polling).
Perfect Aim – Smart raycast target selection (Head → UpperTorso priority), full team + visibility check, respects FOV Circle bounds, smooth CFrame lerp (0.32). Supports “Always On / LeftShift / LMB / RMB / Both” modes.

Visual Systems

Graphic Enhanced ESP – Dramatic neon pink boxes with dual strokes + pulsing gradient, headshot avatars, distance-based skeleton lines (color intensity shifts with range), automatic dead/enemy cleanup, 350-stud culling.
FOV Circle – Glowing pink ring with breathing pulse + RGB animated crosshair. Fully dynamic and respects screen center.

UI / UX (Dramatic Glass-Morphism Theme)

Loading Screen – Full cinematic intro with glitch-shadow title, rotating neon spinner ring, 12 orbiting particle dots, smooth fade-ins/outs.
Main Menu – Glass-morphism frame with dual neon strokes, UIGradient, smooth inertia dragging + momentum glide.
Toggles – 6 premium checkboxes with hover scale + color pulse, checkmark animation, divider, and instant on/off.
Gun Indicator – Live “⚔️ Gun Detected” badge with neon styling.
Aim Mode Selector – Clickable box cycling through 5 modes (including “Both”).
Tooltip – Follows mouse with feature descriptions.
Watermark – Pulsing “NB” with breathing transparency + stroke animation (top-right corner).
Smart Positioning – Auto-centers and clamps to screen edges on resize/respawn.
Notifications + Sounds – Roblox built-in notifications + satisfying toggle SFX.

Controls & Cleanup

Insert – Toggle entire UI visibility.
End – Full graceful shutdown (restores values, disconnects everything, destroys GUI, no memory leaks).
Anti-Detection – Randomized GUI name, jitter delays, pcall safety everywhere, original value backups.
